feature_contract.goal: Keep all original D3DX title/menu/car-selector sprites within the actual current D3D9 backbuffer after resizing/Reset, using one physically bounded affine for full, partial, and pivoted input matrix paths.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only contained OnlineArcade and KeepCentered front-end D3DXMatrixTransformation2D paths, no original sprite geometry replacement, no gameplay ScreenHud, GOAL, stage +TIME, F11, SkyGlow, DXVK, R26_SAFE, or native input/FFB changes.
trace_stages: Original game menu/car-selector D3DXMatrixTransformation2D full, nullable and pivoted call producers use potentially stale screen_scale after Reset.

Existing R84 original custom sprite quad already caps scale against actual screen_resolution; the newly shared affine helper applies that identical physical cap to D3DX menu matrices before game GPU drawing.

Live R84 original D3D9 draw and subsequent OpenXR per-eye presentation can now receive source menu geometry bounded to actual backbuffer, with negative invalid-size fallback retaining original D3DX return and vectors.
subcomponents: Bound the original complete and nullable-vector scale/translation producers with the actual live backbuffer; do not mutate original vectors.
Bound the original pivoted/rotation-only post-D3DX affine while preserving matrix projective, finite and HRESULT fallback gates.
Add C++ numerical positive/negative regression for 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, portrait, Reset with stale game scales and device-loss invalid dimensions.

diagnosis.root_cause: The D3DXMatrixTransformation2D full, partial and pivoted menu matrix paths still trusted the original game's cached screen_scale after Reset, despite custom-sprite and quad paths already bounding their scale by screen_resolution. A stale 1920x1080 scale on a resized 1280x720 backbuffer maps 640x480 content to 1440x1080 and clips right/bottom artwork.
source_trace: src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp D3DXMatrixTransformation2D_dest dispatches three contained front-end input forms into native D3DX.
src/vr/ui/multi_sprite_contain_scale.hpp validates source/target extents and computes the existing physically bounded containment minimum.
src/vr/ui/frontend_affine_contain.hpp builds a common bounded ratio/offset while hooks_uiscaling.cpp applies it before original game draw. No R84 per-eye stereo shader is changed.
alternatives_rejected: Updating only menu_quad_transform.hpp would not affect D3DXMatrixTransformation2D's independent full/partial/pivot submission path; globally resizing VR HudScale would affect unrelated ScreenHud, not correct this source.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The source sprites remain on the existing game R84 UI stereo path; no new stereo owner is granted. Per-eye physical Quest3/VDXR optical output is not observed.
diagnosis.runtime_limit: Source-level numerical and GitHub build validation only. No direct game/Quest3/VDXR visual or frame pacing evidence.
